# Florian Sacchetti Portfolio

> Portfolio of Florian Sacchetti, a Software Engineer specializing in web and mobile application development. The portfolio presents his professional experience, education, technical skills, and selected projects. The website is available in English, French, and Korean.

## About

Overview of Florian Sacchetti's background, software engineering experience, and core technical skills, including web and mobile development.

## Career

Professional experience in mobile, web, and full-stack development, including work with Flutter, Vue, Nuxt, React, Node.js, databases, AWS, analytics, and application architecture.

## Projects

Selected mobile and web projects, including healthcare, housing, and other applications. Each project includes its purpose, technologies used, features, and technical challenges and solutions.

## Education

Academic background in engineering, including a Master's degree in Environment and Energy from Jeonbuk National University in South Korea and engineering studies in Electrical Engineering in France.
